svg.title: UEA and gh-ops
svg.desc: UEA routes engineering work through a keyword classifier to a specialist, sends unknown tasks to an optional local model, and verifies in five tiers: minimal, standard, strict, security, full. gh-ops runs six jobs (daily, monitoring, weekly-report, oss-hunt, security, status) through one dispatcher, the same in CI and locally, and sends a Telegram brief only when a run found something.
